description: Use this when the user asks about large or notable recent trades on Polymarket, for example "show me the biggest Polymarket trades today", "any large trades on the Fed decision?", "who made big trades on the 2028 election", or "trades over $50K this week". Scans Polymarket.com's public trade feed and returns up to 50 of the largest fills in the window (default 15), biggest first: time, buy or sell, outcome, dollar size, shares, price in cents, the market and its slug, and the trader's full wallet address and public display name. Optional filters: a minimum dollar size ($1K to $1M, default $10K), one market or event (a slug, a supported market or event link, a condition id, or plain words), and a window of 1 to 168 hours (default 24). Across all markets, fills at 99¢ or more or 1¢ or less (markets that are effectively decided) are left out, and so are individual sports and esports games and mature topics; name a market to see its trades. Each fill is counted once; dollars are shares times price. Read-only and informational: a large trade is not a forecast, and these tools cannot place trades.

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (default 24, max 168 = 7 days)

limit.description: How many trades to return, largest first (default 15)

market.description: Limit to one market or event: a slug, a supported market or event link, a condition id, or a few words like 'fed october'. Omit for all markets.

min_usd.description: Smallest trade to include, in US dollars (default 10000)

name: get_whale_trades

size_usd.description: US dollars that changed hands (shares x price; a wallet's own fills include the taker fee)

title: Get large trades
